searchText: We can follow up on this pr please leave a comment and here https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/791 I have a question both geth and Nethermind ship a bunch of methods that aren't in the spec some overlap between them (debug_traceTransaction, txpool_inspect, eth_getRawTransactionByHash), others are client-specific. Where do we draw the line? Should everything that ends up across multiple clients eventually get standardized, or is it fine for clients to keep their own methods outside the spec? cc <@259648573401071617> <@372731338031366165> <@194432762315407360> didn't we add spec for debug_trace*? would be cool to see the table of client-specific and overlaps I will make that and share
